question_text: A 2D net of a cube is shown. The net has six squares arranged in a cross shape. The faces have the following symbols: top face has a star, bottom face has a circle, left face has a triangle, right face has a square, front face has a heart, back face has a diamond. Which of the following 3D cubes could be formed from this net? (Assume the net is folded so that the symbols are on the outside.)
